note: Pinned components for the headless-Linux CLI bundle (ADR-0332 decision 1).
Node is pinned by version AND sha256: build.mjs refuses a download whose
checksum does not match. agent-comms is pinned by release tag and full
commit SHA, the way GeniusBar's components.json pins it, so git verifies
the content the archive is assembled from. Bump a pin, then re-run the
build; never edit an assembled archive.

pin_note: The agent-comms this runtime talks to is the qwts repository GeniusBar
bundles, not the unrelated npm package that shares the name. The commit
SHA is the integrity pin: the tag must resolve to it before anything is
fetched, and only the package's own files entries are copied. v0.3.4 has no
npm dependencies, so nothing is resolved or installed into the archive.
The verbs are checked for real, by running the fetched CLI's --help.
